reference.nativeContract: Existing native close min-width/min-height24px and padding0 are applied to the source with public styles.close for comparison; source styles.root/actions maxWidth100% and title/description minWidth0/overflowWrap anywhere preserve existing native wrapping guards; unadapted source close22px/UA padding1px6px retained in a separate observation. Native action alignment, overflow wrapping and top-layer viewport layout are retained; metric scope excludes their positioning CSS.
reference.sourceObservation: The main palette uses uppercase equivalent hex values because the pinned source incorrectly discards explicit lowercase status colors equal to global aliases. Original lowercase results and explicit undefined-width geometry are recorded separately.
reference.operation: Unmodified public notification.useNotification under ConfigProvider, duration0 and stackfalse. Five status/plain variants, slots, close/hover and bottomLeft placement. Nine provider/style scopes. Seven token defaults include progressBg without claiming native showProgress API support.
